description: This PHP source file defines an API class for managing termination reasons within the OrangeHRM system. It provides endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting termination reasons, adhering to REST conventions and incorporating validation rules and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationAPI
classes.description: A REST API class for managing termination reasons, providing CRUD operations with validation and documentation annotations.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonConfigurationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the TerminationReasonConfigurationService instance used for business logic.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all termination reasons with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the list retrieval endpoint.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new termination reason.

methods.name: saveTerminationReason
methods.description: Saves a termination reason entity with provided name data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new termination reason.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove specified termination reasons, with validation to prevent deletion of reasons in use.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete endpoint, ensuring reasons in use are not deleted.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific termination reason by its ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for fetching a single termination reason by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing termination reason by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a termination reason, including ensuring the name is unique.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Helper method to create validation rule for the 'name' parameter with optional unique check.
